notes.title: Looking for feedback; so I made the game FREE this weekend
notes.notes:
I am going to be honest with you here.

PlanTechtor has 100% positive steam reviews, but only from like 10 people.

And I don't know if those people are being nice, or if they really do like the game or not.

I want more feedback.
I want the HONEST truth.
I want to know if people are having fun or not.

So, I am making PlanTechtor free all weekend.

Download now
Play for free
Heck, beat the whole game if you want

All I ask is that you leave an HONEST review. No lies. Good, bad, whatevs.
Just let me know

Thank you
Lester Bloom
FunnerSoft, LLC

notes.title: Translations Updated
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33898592/8b74615f65c61d16725d23eb62983948ea68ba82.png[/img]

I heard the feedback, and am happy to say that PlanTechtor has been updated to include new translations for many languages. This includes:

- New text from volunteer translators
- New fonts
- Better text spacing and placement

As always, please share any feedback you have, and I hope you have fun in PlanTechtor
🤘

notes.title: PlanTechtor climbs the charts on IndieDB
notes.notes:
Yesterday saw PlanTechtor shoot to the front page of IndieDB. It climbed from 400 to 18 in just a few short hours. It was an amazing display of the support that PlanTechtor has been receiving. I can’t wait to share the game with you all in just one short month!
